no_testable_kernel: No testable kernel exists under the isles24 charter. The pitch's central quantity—an aortic-calcification logit from CT-CLIP applied to a Derm7pt image—is not a defined measurement on the named input: CT-CLIP's official repository specifies inference on preprocessed 3D chest-CT volumes, whereas Derm7pt provides 2D clinical and dermoscopic color images. Any conversion of a skin photograph into a CT-like volume would be an arbitrary, out-of-distribution adapter, so a response could not distinguish use of bright-speckle structure from adapter, dimensionality, intensity-scaling, or generic OOD effects. More decisively, Derm7pt is not ISLES'24, so ISLES'24 is not load-bearing and the proposal falls outside the charter. The asserted vendor counts, perfect device split, Gutenberg–Richter fit, synthetic-speckle response, and b-value are also unverified claimed results rather than a prospective model-use design. No modest reformulation preserves the pitch's kernel while satisfying the required ISLES'24 role, computable image quantity, use-versus-association distinction, and one-session decisive experiment.
